newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S'hai Hai Xing sees lower interest costs.
newsitem.headline: S'hai Hai Xing sees lower interest costs.

text.p: Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co Ltd said on Friday its interest rate costs in 1996 will be reduced by about 22 million yuan following China's recent move to reduce the interest rate on fixed asset loans.
The People's Bank of China (PBOC) reduced interest rates on fixed asset loans with a term of five years or more to 12.42 percent from 15.30 percent in late August.

Hai Xing said its bankers confirmed that interest rates on its loans shall be determined pursuant to the PBOC circular, which provided that interest rates on loans should be adjusted to the prevailing rate one year after the date of such loans.
The prevailing interest rate is 12.42 percent and interest rates of the loans would be reviewed on an annual basis.
Hai Xing's outstanding loans amounted to 3.06 billion yuan as of September 20, the company said.
